the camera photo, the chip's own noise and the timing of your taps are hashed together, so your words depend on all three.

an attacker has to beat every one. guessing what you pointed at is not enough, knowing the chip is not enough, and your own timing is the part no manufacturer ever touched.

this is why a dim room cannot give you a weak wallet, and why a bad batch of chips cannot either.
